Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509

Class X509Configuration

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.x509.X509Configuration
@Configuration(value="x509WebConfiguration", proxyBeanMethods=false) @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="authserver.x509", name="enabled", havingValue="true") public class X509Configuration extends Object
Installs the sign-in with a client certificate in the login/UI chain, only while authserver.x509.enabled is true. Nothing outside this feature is edited: the chain applies every LoginChainCustomizer bean, in order, before its catch-all rule.
